decisions.reason: The confirmation concerns updating web-page content and does not entail any change to image ALT attributes.
A web-page content revision does not change the requested coverage of the on-page SEO progress report.
The source concerns web-page content, not the independently defined off-page backlink quantities or link-type percentages.
The confirmation identifies web-page content as the revision target but does not select, replace, or remap any campaign keyword.
The source does not alter the requirement for internal links in blog articles or their destinations.
The local context distinguishes the requested web-page content update from blog content and does not change the selected blog keywords.
The web-page content revision does not change the blog production, article count, delivery window, or publication condition.
The source does not mention or change image requirements for blog articles.
Although an updated blog-topics message precedes the exchange, the clarification and client confirmation specifically identify web-page content as the revision target.
The source does not change the requirement to include search-volume metrics in the keyword research sheet.
